# Dockerfile for llm_studio on llama.cpp
# Environment: Python 3.10, with llama.cpp and llm_studio

FROM python:3.10-slim

# Set environment variables
ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    POETRY_NO_INTERACTION=1 \
    POETRY_VIRTUALENVS_IN_PROJECT=1

# Install system dependencies
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    git \
    curl \
    make \
    libomp-dev \
    libbz2-dev \
    liblzma-dev \
    libsqlite3-dev \
    python3-dev \
    python3-venv \
    && apt-get clean \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Create project structure
WORKDIR /app

# Copy requirements first for better layer caching
COPY pyproject.toml poetry.lock* 2>/dev/null || true
COPY requirements.txt 2>/dev/null || true

# If requirements.txt exists, install dependencies
RUN if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then \
        pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt; \
    fi

# Install llm_studio
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir llm-studio

# Install llama.cpp dependencies
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir \
    torch \
    torchvision \
    torchaudio \
    --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu

# Install llama.cpp (C++ implementation)
RUN git clone https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp --depth 1 --recursive \
    && cd llama.cpp \
    && make -C build-python \
    && pip install --no-cache-dir build-python/install/

# Set up environment for llama.cpp
ENV LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/app/llama.cpp/build-python/install/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}
ENV PATH=/app/llama.cpp/build-python/install/bin:$PATH

# Create necessary directories
RUN mkdir -p \
    /app/llm_studio_config \
    /app/uploads \
    /app/models \
    /app/cache

# Copy application code
COPY . .

# Install additional utilities
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir \
    uvicorn \
    gunicorn \
    fastapi \
    gradio

# Create non-root user for security
RUN groupadd --gid 1000 appgroup \
    && useradd --uid 1000 --gid 1000 --shell /bin/bash --createhome appuser

# Change ownership
RUN chown -R appuser:appgroup /app

# Switch to non-root user
USER appuser

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Expose port for llm_studio web server
EXPOSE 8000

# Default command
CMD ["python", "-m", "llm_studio.train.cli", "--port", "8000", "--host", "0.0.0.0"]

# Dockerfile for llm_studio on llama.cpp

## Overview
This project provides a Docker setup for llm_studio, a web-based interface for training and inference on LLMs, running on top of llama.cpp.

## Quick Start

### Build the Docker Image
```bash
docker build -t llm_studio_llama .
```

### Run the Container
```bash
docker run -d \
    -p 8000:8000 \
    -v ./models:/app/models \
    -v ./uploads:/app/uploads \
    -v ./cache:/app/cache \
    --name llm_studio \
    llm_studio_llama
```

### Access the Web Interface
Open http://localhost:8000 in your browser.

## Prerequisites for Building

### System Dependencies
Before building Docker image on Linux:
```bash
apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    build-essential \
    libomp-dev \
    libbz2-dev \
    liblzma-dev \
    libsqlite3-dev \
    python3-dev \
    python3-venv
```

### Docker
Make sure Docker is running:
```bash
docker --version
docker run hello-world
```

## Directory Structure

- `Dockerfile` - Main build file
- `requirements.txt` - Python dependencies (optional, will be auto-generated)
- `pyproject.toml` - Poetry configuration (if used)
- `README_llm_studio.md` - This file

## Usage Examples

### Training a Model
```bash
# Prepare dataset in ./data
docker run -d \
    -p 8000:8000 \
    -v ./data:/app/data \
    -v ./models:/app/models \
    llm_studio_llama \
    python -m llm_studio.train.cli \
    --port 8000 \
    --host 0.0.0.0
```

### Inference Only
```bash
docker run -d \
    -p 8000:8000 \
    -v ./models:/app/models \
    llm_studio_llama \
    python -m llm_studio.inference.cli \
    --port 8000 \
    --checkpoint /app/models/model.gguf
```

## Configuration

### Environment Variables
| Variable | Description | Default |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `PORT` | Web server port | 8000 |
| `HOST` | Host to bind | 0.0.0.0 |
| `NUM_GPU_LAYERS` | GPU layers for llama.cpp | -1 (all) |
| `NUM_THREADS` | CPU threads | -1 (all) |
| `MAIN_GPU` | Main GPU | -1 |

### Volume Mounts
| Mount | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| `./models` | Store GGUF model files |
| `./uploads` | Training datasets |
| `./cache` | Intermediate files |
| `./logs` | Application logs |

## Security Notes

- Runs as non-root user (`appuser`)
- All dependencies installed with `--no-cache-dir`
- Read-only base image where possible

## Troubleshooting

### GPU Support
For CUDA support:
```bash
# Update base image
FROM python:3.10-cudatoolkit-12.1

# And rebuild with:
pip install torch torchvision torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121
```

### Out of Memory
Reduce batch size or number of GPU layers:
```bash
export MAX_JOBS=4
export NUM_GPU_LAYERS=-1
```

### Build Cache Issues
Clean and rebuild:
```bash
docker builder prune
docker build --no-cache -t llm_studio_llama .
```

## Resources

- [llm-studio](https://llm-studio.ml)
- [llama.cpp](https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp)
- [ollama](https://github.com/ollama/ollama)
